t: The Ansell Disco Slim is a round LED wall and ceiling light designed for both indoor and outdoor applications. Its slim, modern design features an all-polycarbonate diffuser and white trim ring, ensuring durability and a clean aesthetic. Ideal for various settings, including domestic spaces or commercial workshops and corridors. This versatile light offers an internal CCT selector, this allows the installer to choose between 3000K warm white and 4000K cool white colour temperatures at the point of installation, providing flexibility. With an IP65 rating, it is resistant to dust and water ingress, offering reliable performance.
